get.description: Retrieve paginated products with filtering by category, price, search, and sorting

Ranks the catalog by keyword relevance and by embedding similarity, fused with reciprocal rank fusion. The response always reports in its source field which halves were available (hybrid, keyword, semantic). Filters apply to both halves, so total counts only matches the shopper would actually accept.
Ultra-fast product auto-complete suggestions (< 5ms)

product_id.description:
ProductID links the stock row back to the catalog's internal ID; it is
only written when the stock row is first created.

reference_id.description:
ReferenceID makes the adjustment idempotent: retrying with the same
reference returns the original movement instead of applying it twice.
Only honoured for INITIAL_STOCK.
